descriptionChirho: Intransitive Qal sense: to shine, become light, be bright — of daybreak, light itself, or eyes becoming bright.
Nifal (passive/reflexive) sense: to be lit up, dawn upon, or be resplendent and glorious.
Causative Hifil sense: to give light, shine upon, illuminate — of luminaries, lightning, or God providing light.
Hifil in the priestly-blessing idiom: cause one's face to shine upon someone, expressing divine favor and grace.
Hifil sense of physically igniting or kindling a fire or lamp, distinct from emitting natural or divine light.
